about: DropIntel war history: one reading of the Helldivers 2 war every 15 minutes. Times are Unix seconds.

definition.title: STRATEGIC THREAT
definition.briefing: Protect and hold the designated planets in order to destroy the propaganda arrays being established by the Incineration Corps and Jet Brigade, and protect citizens from the Automatons' craven lies.

definition.title: MAJOR ORDER
definition.briefing: Kill the designated enemies to provide footage for the upcoming inspirational education film "Democratic Sniper."

definition.title: MAJOR ORDER
definition.briefing: Liberate the designated planets to secure the raw materials needed to properly honor our fallen heroes.

definition.title: MAJOR ORDER
definition.briefing: Hold the designated planet and eliminate the mandated number of bile-producing Terminids in order to prove the safety of our chemical airstrikes, and to aid vital and fully planned research into airborne toxicity.

definition.title: MAJOR ORDER
definition.briefing: Hold the designated planet, complete the required number of operations, and terminate the mandated quantity of Illuminate hostiles in order to restore peace of mind and full respiratory capacity to our most honored retirees.
